mcp_results.question: For each brass part, which nation provides the cheapest supply? Show part key, nation, and min supply cost.

SELECT 
    P.P_PARTKEY,
    N.N_NAME AS nation,
    MIN(PS.PS_SUPPLYCOST) AS min_supply_cost
FROM 
    PART P
JOIN 
    PARTSUPP PS ON P.P_PARTKEY = PS.PS_PARTKEY
JOIN 
    SUPPLIER S ON PS.PS_SUPPKEY = S.S_SUPPKEY
JOIN 
    NATION N ON S.S_NATIONKEY = N.N_NATIONKEY

    P.P_TYPE = 'BRASS'

    MIN(PS.PS_SUPPLYCOST) = (SELECT MIN(PS2.PS_SUPPLYCOST)
                              FROM PARTSUPP PS2
                              JOIN SUPPLIER S2 ON PS2.PS_SUPPKEY = S2.S_SUPPKEY

ORDER BY 
    P.P_PARTKEY
